XEX delta patcher used by asura_setup.exe to apply the title update (default.xexp) to the disc's default.xex.

Copied unchanged from XenonRecomp (whose patcher is derived from Xenia, BSD; see the file headers) (https://github.com/hedge-dev/XenonRecomp, MIT, LICENSE-XenonRecomp.md):
XenonUtils/xex_patcher.cpp/.h, xex.h, xbox.h, byteswap.h, memory_mapped_file.cpp/.h; thirdparty/tiny-AES-c (aes.c/.h/.hpp, public domain,
unlicense.txt); thirdparty/TinySHA1 (TinySHA1.hpp). The LZX decoder is libmspack's (thirdparty/libmspack, LGPL 2.1).
